title: About Paratmos
description: Paratmos is the company of Mark Westbroek: analyst, data modeller and data architect since 1998, trainer, and builder of his own software.

config.markdown:
Paratmos was founded by Mark Westbroek. The name comes from Ancient Greek and means roughly "beyond the air". That is the programme: IT beyond selling hot air.

## Mark Westbroek

My speciality is clarifying the core concepts of an organisation, with a view to the software that is built for it. I have worked on software since 1998: first as a designer and programmer, then as an analyst, and for the last fifteen years mainly as a data modeller and data architect.

I abstract easily, work methodically and have an eye for detail. I get to know a new domain quickly: within a few weeks to a month or two I can usually hold my own with the experts. Clients often say that I quickly understand what an organisation does and wants.

I studied chemistry in Utrecht and later also trained in body-oriented therapy. The first taught me to think in structures, the second to listen to what people mean. A modeller needs both.

## Also a builder

Besides the work for clients I build my own software: [Omnium](https://omnium.imprint-engine.nl), the model workbench, and [Imprint](https://imprint-engine.nl), the publishing engine this site runs on, which keeps every change as a new version. I also design music electronics, with the hardware and the embedded software that go with it. So what I advise, I have usually built myself.

More about me personally is on [markwestbroek.nl](https://markwestbroek.nl) (in Dutch) and on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/markwestbroek/).
